meta.name: firebase-basics
meta.description: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.

copy.tagline: 快速配置 Firebase CLI 并切换项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚开始接入 Firebase 或需要切换项目环境
copy.tagline_en: Quickly set up Firebase CLI and switch between projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up Firebase CLI or manage Firebase projects from scratch

howto.what: 它会用 npx 运行最新版 Firebase CLI,帮你完成登录、创建或切换 Firebase 项目,并下载 Android 的 google-services.json 或 iOS 的 GoogleService-Info.plist 配置文件。它不用于部署、数据库等 Firebase 功能。
howto.when: 当你要求做 Firebase CLI 登录、创建/切换项目,或下载 App 配置文件(如 google-services.json、GoogleService-Info.plist)时触发。

say.note: 会运行 firebase-tools login 完成登录。

say.text: 创建 Firebase 项目 my-app

say.note: 会执行 apps:sdkconfig 获取配置文件。

howto.what_en: It uses npx to run the latest Firebase CLI, handling login, creating or switching Firebase projects, and downloading Android google-services.json or iOS GoogleService-Info.plist config files. It does not handle deploying or databases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Firebase CLI login, creating/switching a project, or downloading app config files such as google-services.json or GoogleService-Info.plist.

say_en.text: Log me into the Firebase CLI.
Create a Firebase project named my-app.
say_en.note: Runs projects:create; ID must be 6-30 lowercase chars.
Runs apps:sdkconfig to fetch the file.
